agent_tools.name: research_search
agent_tools.description: Search the user's tiered literature knowledge base across metadata, abstracts, user notes, edited reading notes, AI reading notes, cards, annotations, references, and source windows.

limit_entries.description: Max entries to search. 0 = search all entries.

agent_tools.name: analyze_writing_style
agent_tools.description: Retrieve local original Markdown passages for writing-style analysis of an author, journal, paper, introduction, theory section, methods section, or argument structure.

agent_tools.name: get_evidence_pack
agent_tools.description: Return P0/P1/P2 evidence packs for selected entries and a research question.

limit_entries.description: Max entries to search. 0 = search all entries.

agent_tools.name: get_source_windows
agent_tools.description: Fetch local original Markdown source text windows for selected bibliography entries.

agent_tools.name: search_cnki
agent_tools.description: Build CNKI title-search URLs for selected Chinese bibliography entries or provided titles. Returns a batch of URLs that the frontend can open in new browser tabs.

agent_tools.name: lookup_english_fulltext
agent_tools.description: Look up English full-text candidates through existing OpenAlex, Unpaywall, Semantic Scholar, Google PDF, and working-paper search helpers. Does not attach PDFs or write to the database.

agent_tools.name: search_library
agent_tools.description: Search the user's bibliography library by title, abstract, journal, keyword, or tag. Use limit=1000 when listing or scanning the library broadly; do not use 50 as a default.

agent_tools.name: count_library
agent_tools.description: Count matching bibliography entries in the user's library without listing all titles. Use this for questions about how many papers/items exist under current filters.

agent_tools.name: analyze_reading_candidates
agent_tools.description: Analyze a large collection of library papers in batches, write structured working notes, and recommend which papers should be prioritized for deep reading.

agent_tools.name: filter_analysis_cache
agent_tools.description: Reuse the current session's persisted analysis cache and filter it by journal tier, theme cluster, full-text availability, or reading status without rescanning the full library.

agent_tools.name: extract_research_constructs
agent_tools.description: Extract economics/management research constructs, mechanisms, variables, and empirical design hints from local evidence packs or selected bibliography entries.

agent_tools.name: diagnose_research_gaps
agent_tools.description: Diagnose theory, mechanism, measurement, context, and causal-identification gaps from previously extracted economics/management constructs.

agent_tools.name: generate_research_ideas
agent_tools.description: Generate structured economics/management research idea candidates from local constructs and evidence gaps, including research question, hypotheses, data strategy, contribution, and risks.

agent_tools.name: get_entry_detail
agent_tools.description: Get metadata, source file id, and recent workflow timeline for a bibliography entry.

agent_tools.name: get_reading_context
agent_tools.description: Fetch structured deep-reading sections for selected entries so the assistant can compare or synthesize them.

agent_tools.name: start_reading
agent_tools.description: Start a long, quantitative 7-step, or qualitative 4-step reading job for one PDF/Markdown file.

agent_tools.name: start_batch_reading
agent_tools.description: Start reading jobs for multiple file ids.

agent_tools.name: scan_input_folder
agent_tools.description: Read-only scan of the user's uploaded AI assistant inbox batch and compare it with the user's library. Use this when the user asks to see, list, inspect, or tabulate papers. Use offset to continue the next batch after settling working notes. This never imports files and never starts reading jobs.

agent_tools.name: import_folder_and_start_reading
agent_tools.description: Scan the user's uploaded AI assistant inbox batch, select papers related to a topic, and start batch reading jobs. Use only when the user explicitly asks to start/run/batch read/analyze.

agent_tools.name: get_job_status
agent_tools.description: Get status and artifact links for a reading or synthesis job.

limitations: Dynamic extracted templates preserve source fragments but require explicit expression binding before execution.
Mappings do not prove command parity or website administration implementation.
